rationale_one_line: A clean question-answer demonstration (ask, friction, how, answer, close) fits CLASSIC's declarative vocabulary; the story needs no cascade, no scoreboard, no dateline.
writing_tone_notes: Peer-to-peer, declarative, show-don't-tell. Lead the contrast (grep vs a real path), let the tool answer, no superlatives. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: ship graphify's own green-on-dark identity (native --bg and --accent mined)
open in a live session so frame 0 is a working tool
spend the one graph moment on the ANSWER (a lit path), not a node tour
carry two designed brightness beats (the lit path and the flash field)
dont_rules: no node-diagram tour of the whole graph (the killed default)
no on-screen star or growth beat (variety MUST SKIP this run)
no invented terminal commands (only the documented /graphify invocations)
